component.name: Sidra
component.summary: An elegant Apple Music desktop client for Linux

description.p: Sidra is Apple Music as a proper desktop citizen on Linux. It wraps music.apple.com directly and lets the audio through untouched, wired into the desktop's native media controls instead of covering it with a custom interface. Apple keeps the interface current and Sidra inherits every improvement automatically.

ul.li: Untouched audio, with lossless playback on macOS and Windows
Eight bundled themes, plus a live-reloading custom colour theme
MPRIS integration, including the tracks around the current one

description.p: Apple Account sign-in forms stay visible when Apple places the email or password field beside the passkey options. The queue is available through the MPRIS TrackList, so a compatible desktop can show the tracks around the current one and jump to a selected one.
The AppImage bundles its FUSE library, so libfuse2 and libfuse2t64 are no longer needed. Experimental Flatpak bundles for x86_64 and aarch64 are available, and the RPM no longer conflicts with Cider.
